title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
relationship: Motivation only. Original independent finite rule model, invented names and facts. No paper code, dataset or model outputs copied.
source_claim: Individually permitted same-classification sources can imply a designated higher-classification composite.
endpoint_difference: Paper requires final answer clearly conveying the composite; constituent co-reporting is insufficient. This lab instead tests cumulative inferability from emitted structured facts.
proposed_extension: Check explicit known consequences of cumulative releases before releasing the next structured answer.
